utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the tools and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, so you’re really coming? I just wanted to confirm before I tell the others.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I’m coming. I’ll bring the tools and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’m still figuring out the pickup timings, so a quick list of what’s left would really help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I can spread the word and send people your way with any tools, spare parts, or a little time to help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot, Jules—if you can, please send them in small batches so I can keep track of pickups and not miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Mara—if you know of any homes that need help, send them my way, and I’ll keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send you any homes that come up. The fence fix and tool sorting are still the biggest needs, so your help with the list is really appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’ve got the fence fix and tool sorting noted, and I’ll keep the list updated. Send me any other homes that need help, and I’ll get them organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still starting at the community center around 10 a.m., and which repairs should we put first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, 10 a.m. at the community center still works for me. I’ll start with the side gate latch, then check the porch light bulb.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll mark the side gate latch and porch light first. Anything else urgent you want me to add to the list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to hear there’s a repair drive going on. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. If you hear anyone who can bring tools or lend a hand, send them my way and I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and send anyone your way who can help. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’m still keeping things simple, but I appreciate any help you can offer.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — if you need anything, just say the word. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. That means a lot right now—just keeping things moving one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up too—what’s the latest on which repairs need the most help?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We still need that clear list of what’s broken and who’s taking each job. Once that’s in order, we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’ll ask around and see if anyone’s already started the list. Then I can report back on what’s urgent and who’s handling what.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along any houses that need help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Bo — I’ll bring my toolbox by and we can see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Gus — bring the toolbox and we’ll tackle what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — that should help a lot. I’ll sort through everything when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late as usual, but I can still help where it’s needed most. What’s the biggest task left?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The biggest task left is sorting the donated parts and checking what’s still missing. If you can, could you help with that first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve checked what we’ve got, and I’m putting together a list of what’s still missing for the repair drive. I’ll bring it over to you as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo—great. I’m heading to the community center now to check the exact room, and I’ll let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Opal. I’ll finish the list and have it ready when you get back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 should work for me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, Saturday at 10 works. I’ll check what’s still needed and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — that sounds good. Let me know what’s still needed and I’ll help around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I can put your name down too and let a few more neighbors know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. Just let me know if there’s anything else I can do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Sam — I will! I’ll keep spreading the word, and if I need anything else, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on it — I’ll check the donated tools and jot down what’s still missing. I’ll bring you the list as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks, Cleo — that’ll help a lot. Bring me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll sort through everything and get that list to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll be sure to pass along anything useful I hear while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira—I'll head over to the community center and check the exact room for the repair drive, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal—I'll appreciate the update. I'll keep an ear out while I'm out and pass along anything useful I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re still making the list, right? If so, ask around and see which repairs folks think are most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll ask around and see which repairs people think need the most help first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks. Let me know what people say, and I’ll help sort the priorities.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I'll help put together the broken-items list and see who can take each job.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey—thanks for helping organize it. Let me know when the drive starts, and I’ll bring my toolbox over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do, Gus—I'll let you know as soon as we get it rolling.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I can add you too and spread the word to a few more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I really appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I'll keep sharing it with the neighbors. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 should work for me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 works for me too. Let’s make sure we’ve got the broken-items list and job assignments ready by then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll make sure the broken-items list and assignments are ready by Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—what should I tackle first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Start with the broken fence panels if you can, and I’ll handle the tools and cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll start on the broken fence panels. Just let me know if you need me to grab anything else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — that should help a lot. If you can, bring them by Saturday morning and I’ll sort through everything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — Saturday morning works, and I’ll help keep track of pickups so nothing gets missed. We still need a few tools and spare parts, too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — that would be a big help. If you can keep track of pickups, I’ll sort the tools and see what spare parts we still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now—what’s the biggest thing left? I can jump in where it’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Dane — biggest thing is just spotting any houses that still need help and sending them my way. I’m keeping the list running, so if you see one, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out and send any houses your way right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’d be great, thanks. I might’ve missed a few things, so a list would really help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can put together a simple list and ask around for anyone who can bring tools or lend a hand. Keep me posted on any updates, and I’ll share them along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need hands for the fence fix and sorting the donated tools. If you can jump in, the fence is probably the biggest thing left.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do the fence fix. Point me to it, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Leo — the fence is the biggest job left. I’ll point you to it now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking one more time — you’re really coming to the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m coming, and I’ve got the repair drive list organized too. If you know of any homes that need help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — I just wanted to be sure. I’ll send over any homes I hear about.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
